result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd shortlist **BambooHR, Rippling, and Employment Hero**\. However, the best choice depends on whether you need a complete HR management system, payroll, employee scheduling, or just help managing employees.

If your company is based in Canada, I'd also look closely at Canadian payroll and employment compliance before choosing a platform.

## My top 5 HR software recommendations

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall HR platform)

- Employee records and document management
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Vacation and leave tracking
- Performance reviews
- Employee self-service

Best for companies wanting a professional, centralized HR system.

[Visit BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

![Employment Hero revenue, funding & news | Sacra](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fzjrXPaeDGwbU0ktEn3_TQOhXXDHf36IZVXODrp9T7HoPtffJn3log8dcNXgqmxNTVoSA7Z8uruA7pqFNxyUEhGcStTX98s15F3_UqZVdwX3Hil0ScIjHbsYgq5CRV83FbCLkZXcqjEJTHBYwixjaLt2P4LznFNYwuYqYTuorQs3fGdTLjy3xRq6ouhsJUWG?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for small and medium businesses)

- Employee management
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Performance management
- Leave management
- HR workflows and automation

Particularly worth investigating if you want to automate everyday HR administration.

[Visit Employment Hero](https://employmenthero.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

- HR and employee management
- Payroll integrations
- Employee onboarding
- Software and IT access management
- Automated workflows

Great for a company expecting to grow quickly.

[Visit Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Humi | Avalon Accounting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aV3Tyz3-tu3Ua2Xm7WVQBpO1H00xNsE-uXVcxB6M3lZP2UWvHC2vLiEka8eGc6XXEcdljGfg21UMFEqFlr78cWjUpXEuhL40GY9156cDo8EGOuPvuaoz_8cStG_lJOHgN8zNS0RU3dLB24rMLdae3OnVeR8Ge471ucjOzOJdl93ilCYmtpNgcfVfOTm8qiEd?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Humi**

(Best to investigate for Canadian businesses)

- Canadian HR administration
- Employee records
- Vacation and benefits administration
- Onboarding
- Payroll capabilities

Worth considering if your company operates in Canada.

[Visit Humi](https://www.humi.ca/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee database
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management
- HR automation

Good for smaller companies that want core HR features without spending too much.

[Visit Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/)
